name: Mixed-use development base plan
status: Illustrative teaching inputs, not market estimates or source geometry facts
starting_state: Undeveloped site available for purchase; no site control, interim income or existing business
wait_baseline: Do not acquire or build: zero project cash flows and no retained asset
operating_inputs: assumptions.json; retained numerical rates rebased to 2027, without a market or inflation adjustment
growth_convention: One calendar from 2027; operating income and OPEX start only when each package opens
construction_scope: Floor-area rates include the building cores and shared plant. No additional utility-volume construction charge. Each of the 33 floor UUIDs contributes once.
finance_allowance_scope: Fixed teaching allowance for construction finance charges; not a calculated interest schedule. Included in SFFA cost and funding, excluded from unlevered project NPV.
renewal_convention: First renewal at end of fifth operating year, then every five years. Legacy 3.5% growth per payment interval, not annual compounding.

valuation.sale_basis: 2037 net after-capital cash flow, including renewal expenditure due in that year

lending.basis: SFFA threshold: total development cost is a proxy for completed value

funding.draw_timing: Start of year, before construction payments at year end
funding.scope: Construction-period cash diagnostic; no equity IRR, permanent loan repayment or interest optimisation
